digest_definition: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 manifest, sorted by relative path bytes; each regular file contributes path NUL four-digit octal intended mode NUL lowercase content SHA-256 LF; empty directories, uid, gid and timestamps are excluded.
limitations: Hashes establish byte identity and clean patch application establishes reproduction of declared inputs. Neither proves trusted provenance, a security repair, CVE applicability, a successful build, or compliance.
